name: a headline fades out on its own closing word
looks: A bold two-line claim types on, the second line in a lighter grey, and its final word fades to near-nothing just as it lands, as if trailing off mid-thought rather than finishing with punch.
build: First line revealed with kit.typeOn at full opacity; second line types on at reduced opacity from the start; the last word's opacity eases further down (power2.out) rather than holding steady, an inverted landing.
sound: A light typing clack per character, softening to near silence on the fading last word.
prompt: Type on a bold two-line claim, the second line already a lighter grey, and let its final word fade further toward nothing as it lands, trailing off instead of landing with punch, for a quieter, more thoughtful open.
